from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter

writer = SummaryWriter(log_dir="runs/exp1")

for step, (x, y) in enumerate(train_loader):
    loss = train_step(model, x, y, optimizer)
    writer.add_scalar("loss/train", loss, step)

writer.close()
# terminal: tensorboard --logdir runs

import wandb

wandb.init(project="tiny-gpt",
           config={"lr": 3e-4, "batch_size": 64})

for step, (x, y) in enumerate(train_loader):
    loss = train_step(model, x, y, optimizer)
    wandb.log({"loss/train": loss, "step": step})

wandb.finish()
caption: config= attaches hyperparameters to the run permanently.
